column7: Simulate the loaded program in this view (does NOT move the machine).
What the 3D view draws. Changes apply straight away.
The grey lines between cuts. Hiding them leaves only the cutting path.
The material the program cuts into. Hide it to see the whole toolpath, including the parts inside the material.
The table grid: 50 mm squares, heavier line every 100 mm.
The G30 park and toolsetter signs on the bed, and the dot at machine zero.
Zoom and centre so the whole scene fits.
Put the three colours back to the shipped palette.
Lighting and viewing angle change how a colour looks in the view - a surface renders darker than its swatch, and darker still on faces turned away from the light.
The stock is a lit surface, so it renders darker than the swatch and its sides darker again. Cut and rapid are lines, which take the colour exactly.
